name: Portainer CE
description: Docker container management UI, runs as a docker compose stack.
compose:
services:
  portainer:
    image: portainer/portainer-ce:latest
    container_name: panelpro-portainer
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "{{ http_port }}:9443"
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
      - portainer_data:/data
volumes:
  portainer_data:
install_script:
set -e
cd {{ app_home }} && docker compose up -d
echo "Portainer: https://<server>:{{ http_port }}"
uninstall_script:
cd {{ app_home }} && docker compose down -v || true
echo "Portainer stack removed"
